methodology.scope: Every stored record in all six content/data collections; deterministic structural and freshness audit.
methodology.websiteVerification: This script makes no network requests and does not assert that any website was checked. Separate source-check receipts document real retrievals.
methodology.sourceAge: Source accessedAt older than 30 days triggers review; a fresh source timestamp never refreshes dependent records automatically.
methodology.publication: Public counts use the production selectPublishedData gate evaluated for the supplied China calendar date.
methodology.missingFields: Missing facts become follow-up tasks, not guessed values; a passed deadline is historical information, not corruption.
